title: The tensor product of quasi-coherent modules is quasi-coherent, with sections over affine opens the tensor product of sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ be their tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], the sheafification of the presheaf $U\mapsto\mathcal F(U)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X(U)}\mathcal G(U)$, and $t_U:\mathcal F(U)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X(U)}\mathcal G(U)\to(\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)(U)$ the component of the sheafification map. Then $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ is quasi-coherent, and for every affine open $U\subseteq X$ the $\mathcal O_X(U)$-linear map $t_U$ is bijective.

proof.text: On Spec R, choose the counit isomorphisms tilde Γ(F) ≅ F and tilde Γ(G) ≅ G. Apply affine_tilde_tensor to the two modules of global sections. Its sheaf isomorphism proves quasi-coherence of the tensor. Identify its beta with tensorSectionsMap after the semilinear global-section equivalences, by induction on tensors. Transport bijectivity by the counit section isomorphisms and tensorHom_app_tmulSection.

For an affine open U restrict F,G along the canonical chart fromSpec. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence. Use the restriction-tensor comparison and its pure-section identity to transport the affine result. Semilinear restriction-section equivalences induce a tensor equivalence; tensor induction identifies the maps and hence gives bijectivity of tensorSectionsMap F G U.

On each affine-chart restriction the tensor is quasi-coherent, so the tilde counit gives a global presentation by mapping a presentation of the section module. Transport the presentation to the affine open and its over-site. Apply IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop to the standard affine cover.
